upgrade.localImportOriginalReceipts: Authority/persist/publish/finalize/rollback/query/settle v2 bind one epoch/sequence/original transaction and frozen source semantics; business and original positive/negative ACK commit together. upgrade.localImportPersistenceMode: Local authority and Host snapshot-only persistence are mutually exclusive under one mode owner; unsupported restore is rejected before business replacement. Generic source IO/commit uncertainty remains Unknown, not a fabricated permanent refusal.
